new_actionable.classification: Observed visual/state discrepancy requiring owner diagnosis
new_actionable.trigger: After the initial fixture search across 25 sources, enter English keyboard editing and type typed-without-submission without submitting.
new_actionable.actual: The opened current original displays neither the draft text nor the leading search magnifier, although both are visible in the three four-source originals and the retained dense state contains the draft.
new_actionable.required: The actual unsubmitted draft must remain visibly readable in the outlined input; native search layout must preserve its search affordance.
new_actionable.design_basis: Batch draft-preservation focus; frozen C10 identity contract; pw-search outlined input/keyboard contract; UI/UX Forms and Feedback visible content.
new_actionable.scope_limit: Only this assigned dense-draft original is evidenced. Root cause and any other affected cases are not established.

limitations: This is only the four-case affected batch from a partial qualification; it gives no whole-round qualification credit.
All four current originals and all three assigned original references were opened; no prior candidate, seed, other batch, contact sheet or crop was loaded.
Native captures remain 618x824 and references remain 1236x1648; visual comparison uses the declared factor-two relationship without image processing or generated measurements.
Supplemental current-source states have related contract references rather than independent exact-state references. The results reference is contextual feedback support only.
Action, state, metadata, log and provider evidence were read statically and are separated from visible names and appearance. Mechanical PASS is not a visual verdict.
No application, SSH, test, build, probe, validator, hash, SQL, copy or crop was executed. Physical input, e-ink behavior, timing and hardware capabilities are not assessed.
Dense shortcut 00/01 tokens were readable; complete ellipsized prefixes and unpictured dense individual-source selection are not claimed.
The dense blank-input discrepancy is recorded without assigning cause or extrapolating to an unviewed state.
